title: Research Partners
intro: The CBI works with centers and institutes across Pitt, UPMC and beyond — sharing expertise, infrastructure and data.

partners.name: Pittsburgh Center for Kidney Research
partners.description: An NIDDK-funded national resource center (U54 DK137329) for kidney cell biology, physiology and pathobiology — its KIDNIT imaging core, co-directed by CBI's Simon Watkins, develops novel imaging tools built on CBI facilities.

partners.name: Pittsburgh Liver Research Center
partners.description: An NIH-NIDDK P30-funded Digestive Diseases Research Core Center (P30 DK120531) supporting hepatic injury and repair research through pilot funding, scientific core facilities and community enrichment.

partners.name: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center
partners.description: An NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center — the only one in western Pennsylvania — where more than 300 researchers advance basic, translational, clinical and population science research.

partners.name: Brain Image Library
partners.description: The Brain Image Library is a BRAIN Initiative data archive of high-resolution microscopy - petabytes of open data across organisms, techniques, and scales, free for researchers everywhere.
